_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT
OBJECTIVE: HE — Dedicated ADV session and complete strategic inputs: transfer the Strategic Advisor presidio (roadmap, scheduled recalls, assignment delivery) from the HE session to a dedicated ADV session that the operator assigns ACTOR_ID orchestrator with a mandate distinct from IT; keep one campaign and one state (no renewal, no new budget, no fourth assignment); verify continuity and the strategic input pointers. Implementation task closure, ADV presidio and IT's scientific consumers stay distinct.

OBJ_1_STATE.title: Read the canonical instructions, the proactive implementation and the current campaign; state budget, expiry, invocations used, assignments produced/delivered/executed/consumed, the hosting session and its scheduled recall, and defects already fixed; no activate, no new campaign, no counter reset
